description: Change how an existing drawing looks. Get the id from chart_state. Use it to keep several drawings apart — a measured level and a projected one should not be the same colour, and a reader has only the picture to tell them by. Changes the chart you are building; finish with chart_link, or analysis_prepare for a sharing draft that needs human review.

color.description: A palette name. “up” and “down” are the reserved green and red — they assert a bullish or bearish claim, so use them for position zones and not for a measurement.

opacity.description: Strength of the whole drawing, 0.1 to 1. Fade a level that is context rather than the decision.

name: drawing_style
